name: shift-report
title: Shift report
for_each: select distinct ru.run_date::text || '~' || sh.code as id, ru.run_date::text || ' ' || sh.name as label, ru.run_date, sh.starts from runs ru join shifts sh on sh.id = ru.shift_id where ru.run_date >= current_date - 2 order by ru.run_date, sh.starts

sections.title: Machines
sections.sql: select machine, product, crew, total_count as count, scrap as rejects, good, round(availability * 100, 1) as availability_pct, round(performance * 100, 1) as performance_pct, round(quality * 100, 1) as quality_pct, round(oee * 100, 1) as oee_pct from run_oee where run_date::text = split_part($1, '~', 1) and shift = split_part($1, '~', 2) order by machine

sections.title: Stops over 10 minutes, and stops with no reason
sections.sql: select machine, starts_at, minutes, reason_name as reason, note from stop_detail where run_date::text = split_part($1, '~', 1) and shift = split_part($1, '~', 2) and kind = 'unplanned' and (minutes >= 10 or reason = '(no reason)') order by machine, starts_at

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select m.code as machine, ct.name as check_name, cr.result, cr.done_by, cr.corrective_action from check_records cr join machines m on m.id = cr.machine_id join check_types ct on ct.id = cr.check_type_id join runs ru on ru.id = cr.run_id join shifts sh on sh.id = ru.shift_id where ru.run_date::text = split_part($1, '~', 1) and sh.code = split_part($1, '~', 2) order by m.code, ct.code

name: ccp-record
title: CCP monitoring record
for_each: select distinct m.code || '~' || ct.code as id, m.code || ' ' || ct.code as label from check_records cr join machines m on m.id = cr.machine_id join check_types ct on ct.id = cr.check_type_id where ct.code like 'CCP%' and cr.done_on > current_date - 7 order by 2

sections.title: Check
sections.sql: select m.code as machine, m.name as machine_name, ct.name as check_name, ct.frequency, ct.source from machines m, check_types ct where m.code = split_part($1, '~', 1) and ct.code = split_part($1, '~', 2)

sections.title: Last 7 days
sections.sql: select cr.done_on, sh.name as shift, cr.result, cr.done_by, cr.corrective_action from check_records cr join machines m on m.id = cr.machine_id join check_types ct on ct.id = cr.check_type_id left join runs ru on ru.id = cr.run_id left join shifts sh on sh.id = ru.shift_id where m.code = split_part($1, '~', 1) and ct.code = split_part($1, '~', 2) and cr.done_on > current_date - 7 order by cr.done_on, sh.starts
